iso3: # Manual fills for countries with significant WB resource rents but no GRD coverage
# or with stale/partial EITI data that materially understates actual capture.

#   - prefer_over_eiti=FALSE → manual value only used when no GRD and no EITI

iso3: # CATEGORY 2 — EITI override: countries with stale or scope-limited EITI data where manual estimate is more reliable
